messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=api-inference | check=latency_p99 | region=us-east-1 | current=3.8s | SLO=1.2s | burn=3.2x
josh: Acked on PD, I'm on call. Checking dashboards.
maya: Looking at grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/alerts/1769812345 ... p99 spike started ~1769812200, tail concentrated in hotpath GPU nodes.
lee: Seeing elevated queue depth on sidecar. Suspect KV cache misses after eviction.
sam: Can we shift traffic to fallback model-quantized-v2? lower perf but stable.
josh: Good idea. Preparing traffic-split. Will hold 20% to fallback and monitor.
maya: Can someone run quick scale on dedicated pool? autoscaler didn't kick.
lee: Running:
```
kubectl scale deployment/worker-pool-us-east --replicas=24 -n inference
curl -sS https://metrics/api/prom?query=service_latency_p99{region="us-east-1"}
```
sam: scaled to 24, confirmed pods coming up. Rebalancer may take ~40s.
josh: Applied traffic split to fallback: `routerctl set-weight api-inference --variant=fallback-quantized-v2 --weight=0.2`
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert update: acked by josh, status=in_progress
maya: Observability: p99 dropped from 3.8s -> 2.4s after scale+split. Still above SLO but improving.
josh: Noted KV cache miss rate high on these instances. Lee, can you warm prefix cache for top hotkeys?
lee: Warming keys via job:
```
python tools/warm_cache.py --region us-east-1 --keys-file hotkeys_top1000.txt
```
sam: warming started. ETA ~90s.
maya: Customer impact: ~8% of requests degrade >2s, primarily long-context chat flows. Notified CX.
josh: Setting temporary rate-limit to 5rps per-token-heavy-route to reduce tail. Config pushed.
sam: Confirmed rate-limit in place.
lee: Cache warm done. host-17 and host-19 show reduced kv-miss, p99 trending 1.6s.
josh: Rolling rollback plan ready if things go worse: revert traffic split, drain new pods, scale down.
maya: PD note: will keep ack open. Anyone seeing errors/exceptions in logs?
sam: Small spike in OOM on node-19 during warm, recovered after restart. No customer errors observed.
josh: Great. Let's keep 20% fallback and monitor for 10m. If p99 <1.3s for 5m we start gradual ramp-down of fallback.
maya: I'll update incident channel and CX. tagging @lead-eng for postmortem.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: follow-up alert suppressed — awaiting stable metrics.
josh: Thanks team. Stand by for handoff at 1769812945. :thumbsup:
